ops.title: 10.5.0 release collision: two sessions, one version
ops.body: A parallel session (cc-interact pack-migration) pushed to main while your 10.5.0 cut was in flight. State as of 2026-07-20: main is at 2bca7bcd and carries (a) 2fab6236 — a dash-vs-bash fix for tests/test_provision.py missing_script (ubuntu CI red without it) plus a one-line ruff-format join in dispatch.py, and (b) 2bca7bcd — a 'docs(changelog): cut 10.5.0' stamp that DUPLICATES the 10.5.0 heading your local 6e26f85a release commit also adds. Your local stack (bf6c0004..9c6f1126, local tag v10.5.0) includes the other session's features (be4548bb is an ancestor) but not these two commits. When you rebase onto main before pushing: fold the two 10.5.0 changelog sections into one, keep the dash test fix, then re-tag. Nothing else conflicts. The cc-interact session gates its plugin-template ship (floor >=10.5.0) on your tag reaching the remote.
